ak45.curve_basis: Approximate digitization of manufacturer 24V graph; rated point 8Nm/40rpm retained. No extrapolation above 24Nm.
ak45.gains_basis: editable simulation tuning; not manufacturer firmware gains
ak45.command_basis: project SERVO eRPM/(14*36), deg/s=eRPM/84; SPD4500 ACC20000; not MIT protocol limits
ak45.friction_model: smooth output Coulomb approximation of 0.8Nm backdrive specification; exact seal/static drag not measured
ak45.backlash_model: position-servo deadband +/-0.1deg approximation; no separate gear teeth DOFs

xm540.envelope_basis: linear DC envelope approximation from stall/no-load endpoints, NOT continuous torque rating
xm540.cap_basis: provisional simulation cap; not manufacturer continuous specification
xm540.identity_basis: User confirmed J1/J2/J3/J4 XM540-W270-T on 2026-10-10; native motor1..4 already165g in both designs.

xl430.mass_basis: user explicitly specified 57g; retain user mass over rounded manufacturer 57.2g
xl430.cap_basis: retain verified gripper test cap, not manufacturer continuous rating
xl430.envelope_basis: linear DC envelope approximation; firmware PWM dynamics and gearbox compliance unmodeled
xl430.paired_gripper_actuation: Two confirmed XL430 motors drive pinionA/B; coupled angle targets,individual .3Nm provisional caps. Rack mimic is an ideal transmission substitute,teeth collision filtered; all pad/object contacts retained.

l515_imu.bandwidth_basis: gyro47Hz datasheet noise condition; accel25Hz editable simulation assumption
l515_imu.accel_noise_condition: density specified at +/-2g,25C; provisionally used at L515 +/-4g; not measured
l515_imu.bias_distribution: seeded uniform within typical bounds, fixed per run; distribution is assumption
l515_imu.temperature_basis: constant configured temperature; no heat solver
l515_imu.output: float32 specific acceleration including gravity and angular velocity

l515_depth.noise_condition: VGA/95% reflectivity values; provisional XGA noise transfer, not a calibrated XGA noise model
l515_depth.reflectivity_basis: uniform selected test assumption; rendered color is not optical reflectivity

unknown_policy: retain CAD/user joint configuration; do not assign an unconfirmed motor model
controller_commands: AK servo targets in radians; six-wheel speed m/s; gripper/arm existing drives capped per current velocity; no auto-motion at install

arm_J1_yaw.ratio_basis: User confirmed J2=10:1,J3=10:1,all other arm axes no external gearbox,2026-10-10
arm_J1_yaw.gains_basis: editable output-side simulation gains,not manufacturer firmware

arm_J2_shoulder.ratio_basis: User confirmed J2=10:1,J3=10:1,all other arm axes no external gearbox,2026-10-10
arm_J2_shoulder.output_cap_basis: provisional simulation limit; prior project PLG060 J2 10:1 planning value30Nm; NOT confirmed continuous hardware rating
arm_J2_shoulder.gains_basis: editable output-side simulation gains,not manufacturer firmware

arm_J3_elbow.ratio_basis: User confirmed J2=10:1,J3=10:1,all other arm axes no external gearbox,2026-10-10
arm_J3_elbow.output_cap_basis: provisional simulation limit; prior project PLG060 J2 10:1 planning value30Nm; NOT confirmed continuous hardware rating
arm_J3_elbow.gains_basis: editable output-side simulation gains,not manufacturer firmware

arm4_rotation.ratio_basis: User confirmed J2=10:1,J3=10:1,all other arm axes no external gearbox,2026-10-10
arm4_rotation.gains_basis: editable output-side simulation gains,not manufacturer firmware

servo_transmission_note: XM540 manufacturer torque/speed are at its built-in272.5:1 gearbox output. Multiply/divide ONLY the additional confirmed10:1. Public PLG060 catalog is a family reference; exact supplier/efficiency/backlash/inertia remain unconfirmed. All XL430 axes have no external gearbox per user.
fidelity_limits: Motor thermal/current control/firmware communication not reproduced
Camera lens calibration/rolling shutter/stereo matching not reproduced
Rigid CAD/SDF contact is not elastic structural FEA
Passive ball 3R limit box is not measured rod-end cone

toolchanger_motion_model.caveat: Ideal cam transmission; rotor/ball contact replaced by mimic, housing/object contacts retained. Cam elasticity/friction not measured.
